Performance on the course. Ready for everyday life.

Engineered for golfers who demand both performance and style, our Lightweight Tech Pants redefine what stretch golf trousers can be. Designed for freedom of movement on the course and a refined Scandinavian silhouette off it, they’re built to take you seamlessly from tee time to everyday life.

✓ Water-repellent (PFC-free) finish

Everyday performance, everywhere.

products.title: Pleated Trousers - Navy
products.body_html:
The Local Rule Single-Pleated Trousers bring a relaxed Scandinavian approach to classic tailoring. Combining a structured silhouette with everyday comfort, they offer an effortless balance between traditional craftsmanship and modern design.

Why you’ll love them

✓ Soft cotton-blend twill with natural stretch
✓ High-waisted construction
✓ Single front pleat for added volume and shape
✓ Relaxed wide-leg silhouette
✓ Clean hook-and-bar waist closure
✓ Breathable fabric for everyday comfort

Crafted for everyday refinement.

Made from a cotton-blend twill (98% Cotton, 2% Elastane), these trousers offer a soft, breathable feel with just enough stretch for natural movement.

The high-waisted construction creates a clean, elongated silhouette, while the single front pleat adds volume and ease through the thigh. A relaxed wide leg gives the trousers a fluid drape, balancing tailored structure with a more casual expression.

Finished with a minimal hook-and-bar closure for a refined, understated look.

One fit. Relaxed structure.

Relaxed Tailored Fit
– High rise
– Room through hip and thigh
– Wide leg with fluid drape

Versatile by design.

Designed to move effortlessly between everyday settings, the Single-Pleated Trousers pair naturally with knit polos, lightweight layers and tailored outerwear.

A considered wardrobe staple with a relaxed silhouette and timeless appeal.

Fabric & Care

Composition: 98% Cotton, 2% Elastane

The cotton-rich fabric has a natural character and is sensitive to sunlight. Colour fading may occur with direct UV exposure, including during normal outdoor wear, and may become more noticeable over time.

To help maintain the original appearance, follow the care label, wash inside out and dry away from direct sunlight.

Model reference

186 cm / 85 kg
Wears size 32/32

products.title: Local Rule x NNRG
products.body_html:
In envisioning the New Energy Golf concept, we sought to merge the ethereal beauty of the Aurora lights with the dynamic energy of Neo Tokyo, creating a visual symphony that transcends traditional golfing experiences. Our design narrative encapsulates the essence of a burgeoning star, pulsating with cosmic energy and radiating a sense of innovation and modernity.

Drawing from the mesmerizing hues of the Aurora, our palette reflects the interplay of greens, iridescent blues, and ethereal purples, evoking the ever-shifting dance of light across the Scandinavian skies. These colors infuse the golfing environment with a sense of enchantment, inviting players to embark on a journey through a landscape that is both awe-inspiring and immersive.

At the same time, the influence of Neo Tokyo injects a dose of futuristic dynamism into the concept. With sleek architectural elements, futuristic signage, and avant-garde technology seamlessly integrated into the design, New Energy Golf offers a glimpse into a world where tradition meets innovation. This fusion of past and future creates a unique ambiance that appeals to golfers and enthusiasts alike, fostering a sense of excitement and anticipation with every swing.

In essence, New Energy Golf represents more than just a golfing destination; it is a testament to the boundless possibilities of imagination and design. By blending the natural wonder of the Aurora with the cutting-edge vibrancy of Neo Tokyo, we have crafted an experience that transcends the ordinary, inviting players to embark on a journey of discovery and wonder with every round.

products.title: Midlayer Q-zip - Dark Green
products.body_html:
Lightweight warmth. Breathable comfort. Built for layering.

Designed for changing conditions on and off the course, this quarter-zip midlayer combines technical performance with a clean Scandinavian silhouette - making it the perfect layer from cool mornings on the fairway to everyday wear in the city.

Why you’ll love it

✓ Lightweight warmth without bulk
✓ Breathable fabric helps regulate body temperature
✓ Stretch construction for full freedom of movement
✓ Laser-cut ventilation for added airflow
✓ Soft interlock fabric for all-day comfort
✓ Relaxed fit ideal for layering

Built for layering & changing conditions

Made from a technical interlock nylon-elastane blend, this midlayer delivers warmth while allowing excess heat to escape - keeping you comfortable during early tee times, breezy rounds, or shifting weather conditions.

Laser-cut ventilation enhances airflow where you need it most, helping you stay dry and focused throughout your round.

From course to everyday wear

With its relaxed fit and understated Scandinavian design, this is more than a performance layer. Wear it over a polo on the course, under a jacket in cooler weather, or as a versatile everyday piece built for comfort and mobility.

Performance meets comfort

The smooth interlock construction provides a soft feel against the skin while maintaining structure and durability. Stretch mobility ensures unrestricted movement through every swing, step, and commute.

Fit & sizing

Relaxed fit designed for comfortable layering.
